title: Iranian influence nexus: Cross-platform activity
summary: OpenAI banned Iran-linked accounts using AI to generate articles and social posts tied to IUVM and STORM-2035 influence activity.
body: OpenAI banned Iran-linked accounts using AI to generate articles and social posts tied to IUVM and STORM-2035 influence activity.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布报告称，封禁了一批来自伊朗的关联账户。这些账户利用大模型自动生成文章和社交媒体帖子，从事与IUVM和STORM-2035相关的网络影响力活动。该事件揭示了生成式AI技术在跨平台地缘政治宣传和虚假信息传播中的滥用风险。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI披露了封禁伊朗关联AI生成虚假信息的账户情况，反映了大模型在安全对抗中的实际应用。
